_comment: How many distinct collage arrangements the generator can actually choose
from, per photo count, for Dan's photos (every frame 3:2 landscape).
Generated from distinct_collage_splits, which filters on TWO things now.
The crop budget, via split_fits_photos, drops arrangements that would
squeeze a photograph into a sliver. Since #921 the phone chrome drops
arrangements that would bury one behind Instagram's caption: the collage
is the only static template whose layout varies, so it was the only one
nobody had positioned against the chrome.
The counts fell when that second filter arrived, most at the larger sizes,
because a row of small photographs at the foot of the frame is exactly
what lands in the band. Ten photographs went from 20 arrangements to 8.
Regenerate with tests/test_collage_arrangements.py, which fails when this
file and the live function disagree. The Swift 'New layout' button reads
the same file, so re-check it when these move.
